status: locked after prediction sealing and before truth opening
matched_ablation: single deterministic V22 numeric prediction with identical anchor and numeric branch
regime_aggregation: equal arithmetic mean of generalized_translation and setup_translation family-macro metrics
primary_action: family macro mean: rows within family/protocol, then equal three protocols, equal two regimes, equal 72 families
strong_numeric_point: lowest point mean among fixed unit RGB, Huber 1.345 RGB, and Cauchy 2.385 RGB
strong_numeric_bootstrap: within each paired family resample, take the lowest sampled mean among the same three fixed numeric methods

protocol_harm_gate.reference: lower cell action MAE of the globally strongest fixed numeric method and frozen legacy adapter

proper_score_gate.scope: equal mean of two regime family-macro scores
proper_score_gate.eligible_references: globally strongest fixed numeric method and frozen legacy adapter

uncertainty_width_gate.definition: family-macro mean active-coordinate axis diameter of the joint 90% Gaussian ellipsoid
uncertainty_width_gate.reference: same method selected by the active CRPS gate

exclusions: none; all 1080 sealed episodes are scored
